Sunset Glam

Warm copper and gold tones for a golden-hour flush.

Shop this look

About this look

Sunset Glam pulls the golden hour onto the face: copper and gold shadow, a flushed warm cheek and a glossy nude lip. Made for evening light and candlelit rooms.

The direction

  • Copper-to-gold shadow gradient
  • A flushed warm cheek
  • A glossy nude lip

How to recreate it

  1. Press a copper shade across the lid and blend upward.
  2. Layer a gold shimmer on the centre of the lid.
  3. Warm the cheeks with a peach blush.
  4. Line and fill the lips, then add a clear gloss.
